name: ServiceDesk Plus
summary: ServiceDesk Plus from ManageEngine sells three editions, in the cloud or on your own servers. The Standard edition is free for up to five technicians and starts at $13 per technician a month otherwise. Professional starts at $27 and Enterprise at $67. Incident management and SLAs come in Standard, but the service catalog is an add-on there and included in Enterprise. A 30-day trial is offered.

facts.text: The relationship map help page says users can analyze the impact a CI has on a business service, and that the map shows the number of pending requests, problems and changes.
The CMDB page says CI records can be populated by discovery scans, and that the CI inventory shows CIs together with their dependencies and associations.
The CMDB enhancements page says the complete picture of the CIs involved in a change helps change advisory boards account for potential service impact.
The free Standard edition covers up to five technicians and only one service desk instance can use that allowance.
End users are not charged, and each service desk instance is billed separately.
The pricing page lists the service catalog as a $1,195 a year add-on on Standard and Professional, and as included in Enterprise.
The page says prices are current as of September 2026 and subject to change.

hiddenCosts: On Standard and Professional, the service catalog and problem management are each a $1,195 a year add-on.
Change and release management is a $2,395 a year add-on on Standard and Professional.
Professional and Enterprise prices also depend on the number of IT assets.

contract.cancellation: The pricing FAQ says users can upgrade, downgrade or cancel at any time.
